scores.evidence: The s3-diagram flowchart TD is readable at 390 px. Its labels are Japanese and break cleanly, and s3-table right below names the 決まったファイル (pages/mobile-jp-09.png, pages/mobile-jp-10.png). The tables, steps, prompts and quizzes do not overflow on any screen (overflowX false). One code line the learner has to type wraps in a misleading way on mobile (pr-code, pages/mobile-jp-22.png).

textOnlyScreens is empty on both devices. A heading, definitions, a table, a figure or a check appears on every screen, and an inline check closes each of 5-1 to 5-5 (pages/mobile-jp-04.png, -07, -11, -17). Desktop charsPerLine median is 39, inside the 30–40 target.

This is a Japanese-only lesson and no stray English UI shows. Terms carry their English on first use (セッション（session）, コンテキスト圧縮（compaction）), and the diagram has Japanese labels and an alt text. Contrast is fine on the callout, the quiz cards and the dark code blocks, and no controls are hidden under the top or bottom bars (pages/mobile-jp-11.png, pages/mobile-jp-34.png).

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the line `echo '- <title>は「練習：」から' > CLAUDE.md` soft-wraps right after `>`. `CLAUDE.md` then sits alone on the next row with only a small indent, and no line number shows that it continues the line above. The step above it (pr-start) tells learners to run the commands 1行ずつ, so a learner typing from a phone can enter `echo ... >` and `CLAUDE.md` as two commands.
mustFix.fix: Make every line in the block fit in about 36 columns on mobile. One way is to move the CLAUDE.md content into its own code block (filename `CLAUDE.md`, one line `- <title>は「練習：」から`) and have the terminal block create it with a short command, or have the learner create the file in an editor, as the PowerShell troubleshoot already does. Another way is to shorten the echo text so the whole command stays on one line.

niceToHave: The first objective (o1) breaks inside a word on mobile, as 見分 / け、/clear・/compact・…, because the run of slash commands is kept together (pages/mobile-jp-01.png, pages/mobile-jp-33.png). Rewording it so the commands come later (for example 「/clear・/compact・サブエージェントから、失敗パターンに合う対処を選べる」) would avoid the break.

s5-check option b: on desktop the full-width example number splits across lines as １２３ / ４５６７ (pages/desktop-jp-12.png). Shortening the option or moving the example to the end of the sentence would keep the number on one line.

s4-table: on mobile, the long bold first-column cells (pattern name + English + symptom) form heavy bold blocks in a narrow column (pages/mobile-jp-12.png, pages/mobile-jp-13.png). Making only the pattern name bold and keeping the symptom in regular weight, or putting the symptom in the second column, would read more easily.
s2-table row 3, right column: on mobile the cell breaks unevenly (起 / きたら、指示が / 残っている…) (pages/mobile-jp-06.png). A shorter cell such as 「自動で起きる。指示が残ったか確かめる」 would wrap more evenly.
reader: the desktop charsPerLine max is 53, over the 40 target, though the median of 39 is in range. The column width is set by the reader.

reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (pages/mobile-jp-34.png, pages/desktop-jp-22.png). 13 failed /api/ requests were ignored as environment noise, and the mobile full-length PNG is truncated. None of these come from the lesson.
summary: The screens are well paced: every screen has a heading, figure, table or check, and the 5-3 flowchart (TD) is readable at 390 px. The main fix is the practice setup command (pr-code): on mobile it wraps after the `>` redirect, and a learner told to run commands 1行ずつ could type it as two commands. The metrics have no hard failures, and no personal data appears on any screen.
